# Separate RPC components into packages

## Pull Request by @skoszuta

Separate package for RPC client.
Separate package for validation schemas and type definitions shared between RPC server and client.
browser-friendly event emitter in the client.

## Walkthrough

Imports and types used across the RPC codebase were consolidated into two new packages: `@typeberry/rpc-validation` and `@typeberry/rpc-client`. Many handler and server modules now import Handler, RpcError, validation, JSON_RPC_VERSION, and related types from the rpc-validation package instead of local files. SUBSCRIBABLE_METHODS was added and exported from the new validation package and removed from bin/rpc/src/subscription-manager.ts. Workspace and package manifests were updated to include the new packages and adjust dependencies.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25–35 minutes

- Verify re-exports in packages/jam/rpc-validation/index.ts and types.ts.
- Review addition and typing of SUBSCRIBABLE_METHODS in validation.ts and removal from subscription-manager.ts.
- Check import swaps across bin/rpc handlers and server to ensure no runtime import/token differences.
- Inspect new rpc-client package for EventEmitter replacement and logger init change.

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#381 — Touches RPC subscription machinery and the same exported symbols (subscription-manager / SUBSCRIBABLE_METHODS).
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#402 — Adds zod-based parameter schemas and subscription mappings; overlaps validation and subscription exports moved here.
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#428 — Modifies JSON-RPC validation/types and server request handling; relates to the refactored validation/type surface.

**Refactor EventEmitter import to use default export**

`eventemitter3` v5.0.1 exports EventEmitter as a default export, not a named export. The current named import will fail in ESM tooling:

```diff
-import { EventEmitter } from "eventemitter3";
+import EventEmitter from "eventemitter3";
```

Without this change, `EventEmitter` will be `undefined` at runtime in ESM contexts, breaking the `SubscriptionEventEmitter` class definition (lines 31–35) and all subscription handling.

Note: `eventemitter3` is already properly declared in `package.json` dependencies.
